incidentbot: PagerDuty — PAGE FIRED: <https://pagerduty.com/incidents/INC-4267|INC-4267> embeddings-prod-eu — High error rate (5xx). Alert rate: ~120/min. Affected routes: /v1/encode. Pager: oncall-eu
maria: acked :rotating_light: I'm on it, triaging logs.
kai: seeing 502s from embedder-2 pods in eu-west-1, tailing logs now. `kubectl -n prod logs -l app=embedder -c main --since=5m`
raj: pinging infra autoscaler, can we confirm pods aren't OOMing?
sre-liz: infra checks ok, CPU/memory stable. network errors showing TLS handshake timeouts on a subset of nodes.
maria: adding context — customer A reported failed bulk embeddings at 09:12 UTC with ~30% success rate. customer B also flaky.
kai: i can reproduce locally against embedder-2: short-lived 502s when concurrent requests > 200. Suspect connection pool exhaustion.
maria: switching route to fallback model variant `embedder-v1-small` for customer A to reduce impact. Command:
```
POST /routing/v1/set-fallback
{ "service": "embeddings-prod-eu", "variant": "embedder-v1-small", "selector": "customers:A" }
```
raj: done, routing change applied. customer A success rate up to 96% — monitoring.
sre-liz: can we scale embedder-2 by +3 replicas as mitigation? will monitor for side effects.
kai: scaled +3, watching logs. still seeing occasional 502s but overall traffic handled.
maria: handing off to raj for long tail and rollback plan. i'll continue postmortem draft. @raj please update INC with current mitigation and cust impact.
raj: taking over. will keep short pings here every 5m. next ping in 5.
incidentbot: Incident updated: INC-4267 assigned to raj. Status: Mitigated (partial).
